blind.second_guess: wall-mounted key rack or coat rack with bells
blind.description: A wooden wall-mounted servant bell indicator board (annunciator board). It features a polished brown wooden rectangular frame with decorative side pilasters and a top moulding. Mounted inside the recessed front panel are five shiny brass bells suspended from curved brass brackets, each with a small white rectangular label or nameplate plaque directly beneath it. The reverse side (seen in Tile D) is a smooth, panelled wooden back. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no holes, floating shards, or melted areas.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a long, narrow brown rectangular bar with slightly wider rectangular caps at both ends, and five protruding circular golden bell domes lined up along the lower front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: It stands about 1.5 to 1.8 feet tall (roughly one-fourth to one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
